title: SAHC-NS: Structure-Aware and Hardness-Calibrated Negative Sampling for Implicit Collaborative Filtering
abstract: arXiv:2608.16587v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Negative sampling is a key component of implicit collaborative filtering (CF), as it enables recommenders to effectively learn user preferences. Existing negative sampling methods mostly follow a two-stage paradigm: they first construct a candidate negative pool for each user and then select negative samples from the pool according to predefined sampling rules. However, these methods usually overlook the hardness variation of candidate negative pools across users, making it difficult to adaptively adjust the hardness and informativeness of negative samples according to candidate-pool conditions. In addition, most existing samplers evaluate candidate negatives mainly through a matching score computed from the final aggregated user and item embeddings, while ignoring the structural differences captured by multi-hop neighborhood aggregation. translated_title: SAHC-NS：面向隐式协同过滤的结构感知与硬度校准负采样
translated_abstract: 负采样是隐式协同过滤（CF）的关键组成部分，它使推荐系统能够有效学习用户偏好。现有的负采样方法大多遵循两阶段范式：首先为每个用户构建候选负样本池，然后根据预定义的采样规则从池中选择负样本。然而，这些方法通常忽略了不同用户候选负样本池的硬度变化，难以根据候选池条件自适应调整负样本的硬度和信息量。此外，大多数现有采样器主要通过从最终聚合的用户和物品嵌入计算出的匹配分数来评估候选负样本，而忽略了多跳邻域聚合捕获的结构差异。因此，负样本的训练价值可能无法被充分表征。为解决这些问题，我们提出了SAHC-NS方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结构感知与硬度校准的负采样方法，通过自适应调整负样本硬度并利用多跳邻域结构信息，有效提升隐式协同过滤的推荐性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a structure-aware and hardness-calibrated negative sampling method that adaptively adjusts negative hardness and leverages multi-hop neighborhood structure to improve implicit collaborative filtering performance.
